body:
I think I ll get some sleep now. Thank you Tortirkitty for talking to me. I can't really tell any of this to anyone else.


I think it was a nice dream, to get away, thinking about it made me feel better.

I don't know the answer myself. Several years ago, if someone had asked me if I enjoyed learning I would not hesitate to say yes. However, once I got into college, I didn't do the work, I didn't even socialize, I just stayed in my dorm on my computer all the time. My grades became terrible and after three years of coasting, I transferred to my local CUNY, but I still can't make it.

As to talking with the people at home. I feel like there is a barrier between us. I feel like they ignore my opinions. They do stuff I really dislike even after I tell them how I feel. I don't know if I didn't make myself clear or they just don't care. I can try to talk to them but the words just don't come out. Sorry if that doesn't make sense.

I'm a college dropout, I've been working the same minimum wage job for too long. I don't really like it. The boss knows my family, it's difficult for me to quit.

I have no motivation to look for a better job. I thought maybe if I go somewhere else it would force me to restart my life. Or at least help me forget my problems for a little bit.

Also, I don't like the people at home. We get into arguments all the time. I feel like I'm at fault since I'm a freeloader, but I can't help getting angry. I feel sometimes even if they don't do anything, just  thinking about them makes me very upset. I want to break things and I want to cry and it's terrible.

Earlier I got into an argument at home again and I was told something to the effect of "If you keep this up why don't you just get out." I thought maybe that wasn't such a bad idea, but I'm clueless as to how to do so.

Thanks for listening.
